records.eventLabel: FIS Snowboarding World Championships 2013 – men's snowboard cross
records.text: On January 24, 2013, FIS Snowboarding World Championships 2013 – men's snowboard cross began in Stoneham-et-Tewkesbury.
records.textJa: 2013年1月24日、FIS Snowboarding World Championships 2013 – men's snowboard crossが始まった（Stoneham-et-Tewkesbury）。

records.eventLabel: FIS Snowboarding World Championships 2013 – men's snowboard cross
records.text: On January 26, 2013, FIS Snowboarding World Championships 2013 – men's snowboard cross ended in Stoneham-et-Tewkesbury.
records.textJa: 2013年1月26日、FIS Snowboarding World Championships 2013 – men's snowboard crossが終わった（Stoneham-et-Tewkesbury）。
